name: projipsa
description: A project memory butler: source-backed understanding, decisions, history, and continuity across Codex, Claude Code, and Grok Build.

interface.shortDescription: A project butler for durable project memory.
interface.longDescription: Projipsa keeps project understanding current and source-backed. Query and maintain memory, explicitly onboard existing projects, and audit or compact accumulated artifacts across Codex, Claude Code, and Grok Build.
defaultPrompt: Use $projipsa:projipsa to brief me from this project's maintained memory.
Use $projipsa:projipsa-init to onboard this existing project.
Use $projipsa:compact to audit this project's memory for safe compaction without deleting anything.
